statement: xpad's wireless presence worker creates/registers a new input and LED device when a pad attaches, and on detach clears its RCU input pointer, synchronizes readers, then unregisters the devices. A later attach allocates another input device instead of reviving a persistent evdev node; the exact event node number is host-dependent.
